scope_note: Four dated sets keep forum-native PHPBB smilies distinct from QQ/IM references, then show Tieba's 2014 catalog preview, a separately identified 2020 mobile extraction, and the actual current 2026 app preset. All dates describe release/listing/app evidence, not inferred drawing creation dates.

timeline_groups.date_basis: Official phpBB release announcement dated 2010-11-20; source GIFs are from the release tag's phpBB/images/smilies directory.
timeline_groups.license: GPL-2.0; COPYING from the release package is included. Verify the individual image licensing terms before public redistribution.
timeline_groups.rights_note: The release package includes GPL-2.0 COPYING. The exhibition should credit the phpBB Project and preserve the individual asset notices/terms.

source_apk.corroboration_note: The official Baidu Mobile Assistant listing and Tencent MyApp listing both report version 22.12.1.0. Baidu lists 2026-09-24; Tencent MyApp lists 2026-09-23. Use the Baidu date as primary and preserve the one-day listing discrepancy in provenance.
source_apk.download_source: Tencent MyApp CDN URL provided by the current Baidu app listing flow
source_apk.apk_md5_check: Matches the 32-hex package identifier in the official Tencent CDN filename.
limitations: The preset is the default emoji package embedded in the 2026-09-24 Android app build; this does not establish when each individual drawing was first created.
The app APK was not added to the repository. Only the compact nested preset archive, its package metadata, and original WebP assets are retained.
The CDN package hash was checked; no separate publisher certificate allowlist was available in the local project.

timeline_groups.rights_note: Extracted from Baidu Tieba's app package; Baidu retains the underlying artwork rights. Use only as internally reviewed reference unless exhibition rights are cleared.
